surfaces: procurement expected/observed state constructor and helper timestamp invariants

contract.authoritative_inputs: ExpectedRequirement, ObservedProcurement and ExpectedObservedState arguments; explicit Decimal quantities, canonical key, StateScope, as_of, evidence and freshness; existing Issue118/ADR020.
contract.authoritative_output: Valid immutable expected/observed records or rejection; existing latest-in-scope/as-of pairing and outstanding/freshness output.
contract.scope_as_of: Full tenant/project/site/version equality when paired. Every material record and helper cutoff is timezone-aware (tzinfo and non-None UTC offset). Valid offsets and distinct record timestamps are preserved.
contract.governing_policy: ADR020/024 and Issue118 intrinsic validity; finite nonnegative quantities; overages remain representable for anomaly policy. No new authority/aggregation/unknown-value policy.
contract.evidence_retained: Original evidence tuples and scopes/as_of; regression RED/GREEN, property cases, public installed proof, public challenge/mutation results, exact revisions and review.
contract.typed_failures: Existing quantity/key/scope/evidence ValueError behavior retained. Invalid as_of raises existing TemporalContractError, a ValueError subclass, with stable temporal contract code. No new error vocabulary.

scenarios.rationale: Empty helper inputs still validate time; missing observation remains None/UNKNOWN; empty evidence rejects.
All quantity fields validated independently; pair key/every scope axis; existing latest/as-of multiple-record selection preserved.
Naive and offsetless reject, legitimate offsets and different record times remain valid; full scope identity.
Negative/nonfinite reject; zero/fractional/large/nonnegative quantities and overages preserved.
Offsetless timestamps and missing evidence rejected at public typed boundaries.
Actual constructors/helpers are public Python API; clean installed execution and shipped integration callers must be qualified in Task3.
Overages, unknown/partial freshness, valid offsets and unchanged governing policy remain valid.
